name: Random Maze
description: Escape the maze! Every time you open this level the walls, your starting tile and the green goal tile are different, so a hard-coded path will not work.
Your robot starts facing east. Write a program that can solve any maze.
hint: Try the right-hand rule: if the right side is clear, turn right and move; otherwise move forward if the front is clear; otherwise turn left. There is no turn_right(), but three left turns equal a right turn. Loop with while not at_goal().
